user_intent: 如果 人在家 那么 增加 亮度
期望 温度 处于 31 ℃
期望 湿度 处于 54 % 到 68 %
IF 人不在家 THEN 清洁环境
如果发生火灾，那么开始报警
如果发生火灾，那么打开逃生通道
人离开时，关闭所有影音、照明、环境控制及厨电类电器
standard_taps: IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN turn_light_up() philips_zhiyi_light
IF qingping_air_monitor.reading_temperature() > 31 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN set_mode_to_cool() smart_inverter_air_conditioner
IF qingping_air_monitor.reading_temperature() < 31 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN set_mode_to_heat() smart_inverter_air_conditioner
IF sprite_temperature_humidity_sensor_KD30.get_humidity() > 68 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN turn_on() deerma_dehumidifier
IF sprite_temperature_humidity_sensor_KD30.get_humidity() < 54 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN turn_on() deerma_humidifier
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN start_sweep() viomi_vacuum
IF LG_fire_detector.is_fire() == true THEN beep() LG_fire_detector
IF LG_fire_detector.is_fire() == true THEN open_door() Blade_Star_smart_door
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN turn_light_off() philips_zhiyi_light
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN turn_off() smart_inverter_air_conditioner
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN turn_off() deerma_humidifier
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN turn_off() deerma_dehumidifier
